goals.gate: Eligible cohort reproducible; every play-track account has verified signals, matched play, ROI narrative, and CRM opportunity

gates.description: Expansion doctrine loaded (expansion-playbook, expansion-plays, usage-to-value-map read this session)
gates.command: grep -lq 'expansion' ~/.claude/skills/expansion-playbook/SKILL.md && echo LOADED in session log

gates.name: 0.2 Operating mode declared: analysis + drafts only; zero custom
gates.description: Operating mode declared: analysis + drafts only; zero customer contact without approval

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_expansion declared with all 8 components
gates.description: Harness tuple H_expansion declared with all 8 components

gates.name: 1.1 Eligible account list produced by reproducible query: seat u
gates.description: Eligible account list produced by reproducible query: seat utilization, feature adoption, plan ceiling proximity, tenure
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/eligibility_query.sql + eligible.json; re-run hash matches; jq 'length >= 1' true or explicit empty-cohort note

gates.name: 1.2 Expansion signal verified per account: usage metric crosses
gates.description: Expansion signal verified per account: usage metric crosses the declared threshold with the actual series attached
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/signals.jsonl — per account: metric, threshold, observed_value, series_id; all observed_value >= threshold

gates.name: 1.3 Suppression applied: accounts with open churn-risk flags, un
gates.description: Suppression applied: accounts with open churn-risk flags, unresolved escalations, or in-flight negotiations excluded with reason codes
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/suppressed.json — every excluded account has reason_code from declared enum

gates.name: 1.4 Champion identified per account: named contact with engageme
gates.description: Champion identified per account: named contact with engagement evidence, or account is downgraded to 'nurture' track
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/champions.json — per account: contact_id + last_engagement date, or track: nurture

gates.name: 2.1 Play selected from the expansion playbook by signal type, wi
gates.description: Play selected from the expansion playbook by signal type, with the selection rule recorded
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/play_selection.json — per account: play_id + selection_rule; every play_id exists in expansion-playbook index

gates.name: 2.2 ROI narrative computed from the account's own usage data (us
gates.description: ROI narrative computed from the account's own usage data (usage-to-value map): hours saved, seats utilized, features adopted — with numbers, not adjectives
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/roi/<account>.md — every value claim cites a metric from signals.jsonl; grep -c 'hours\|seats\|%\|\$' >= 3 per file

gates.name: 2.3 Proposal draft exists per account with concrete ask: tier, s
gates.description: Proposal draft exists per account with concrete ask: tier, seat count, or module — and the price is stated, not implied
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/drafts/<account>.md contains explicit ask line with amount; scripts/ask_scan.py exit 0

gates.name: 2.4 Objection pre-mortem: top 3 likely objections per segment wi
gates.description: Objection pre-mortem: top 3 likely objections per segment with prepared responses
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/objections.md — >= 3 objections with responses per represented segment

gates.name: 3.1 CRM opportunity records created per account with play_id, am
gates.description: CRM opportunity records created per account with play_id, amount, stage, and next_step
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/opportunities.json — Twenty API record ids; count equals play-track account count

gates.name: 3.2 Forecast impact computed and logged: pipeline delta by close
gates.description: Forecast impact computed and logged: pipeline delta by close-month, confidence-weighted
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/forecast_delta.json with per-month expected_value and weighting method stated

gates.name: 3.3 Gate-D approval before any customer-facing outreach: typed A
gates.description: Gate-D approval before any customer-facing outreach: typed APPROVE <run_id> per account batch
gates.command: artifacts/expansion/<run>/gate_d.log APPROVE lines; absent them all drafts remain arm: false

gates.name: 3.4 Playbook feedback loop: session learnings (signal quality, o
gates.description: Playbook feedback loop: session learnings (signal quality, objection hits) appended to the expansion playbook log
gates.command: append to ~/.hermes/jake/expansion/playbook_feedback.jsonl with run_id and >= 1 learning

preconditions.startup_phrase: Expansion play session. Expansion is earned by demonstrated value. Upsell without usage evidence is spam with a CRM entry.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_expansion(eligibility, signals, play, champion, roi_narrative, crm_records, forecast, approval)
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for eligibility and signal checks; A2 for play selection and ROI math; A3 for narrative drafting; A4 never — customer contact is Gate-D

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times; a signal threshold producing 3 consecutive dead plays is recalibrated

success_conditions: Eligible cohort reproducible; every play-track account has verified signals, matched play, ROI narrative, and CRM opportunity
Suppressed accounts carry reason codes; nurture-track accounts carry champion-gap notes
Drafts armed only with approval; forecast delta logged
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict (plays-staged | partial | blocked), next safe action in session log
failure_states: stop gate(s) 3.3: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.4, 2.3, 2.4, 3.2, 3.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Expansion doctrine loaded (expansion-playbook, expansion-plays, usage-to-value-map read this session)
Operating mode declared: analysis + drafts only; zero customer contact without approval
Harness tuple H_expansion declared with all 8 components
Eligible account list produced by reproducible query: seat utilization, feature adoption, plan ceiling proximity, tenure
Expansion signal verified per account: usage metric crosses the declared threshold with the actual series attached
Suppression applied: accounts with open churn-risk flags, unresolved escalations, or in-flight negotiations excluded with reason codes
Champion identified per account: named contact with engagement evidence, or account is downgraded to 'nurture' track
Play selected from the expansion playbook by signal type, with the selection rule recorded
ROI narrative computed from the account's own usage data (usage-to-value map): hours saved, seats utilized, features adopted — with numbers, not adjectives
Proposal draft exists per account with concrete ask: tier, seat count, or module — and the price is stated, not implied
Objection pre-mortem: top 3 likely objections per segment with prepared responses
CRM opportunity records created per account with play_id, amount, stage, and next_step
Forecast impact computed and logged: pipeline delta by close-month, confidence-weighted
Gate-D approval before any customer-facing outreach: typed APPROVE <run_id> per account batch
Playbook feedback loop: session learnings (signal quality, objection hits) appended to the expansion playbook log

final_rule: No expansion ask without usage evidence that crosses a declared threshold.
No ROI narrative built from adjectives; every value claim cites the account's own metrics.
No customer contact without typed Gate-D approval for this exact batch.
Every expansion play session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
